home.title: A frontend baseline, not a finished product.
home.description: Start with reusable components, consistent interaction states, two theme presets, and a clean integration boundary. Bring your own product requirements.

components.title: Reusable UI
components.text: Accessible controls, overlays, calendar, query input, and sharing. Interactive examples use local fixtures.

integration.title: Fullstack boundary
integration.text: The existing API client, versioned backend contract, and same-origin proxy remain unchanged.

docs.title: One documentation home
docs.text: Frontend standards live in docs/engineering/frontend. Product requirements and cross-service contracts stay at the repository root.

global.title: The application hit an unexpected error.
global.description: Your data is unchanged. Reload the page to retry, or return home to start again.

route.title: This page could not be displayed.
route.description: The route failed while loading. Reload the page, or return home and try another path.

notFound.title: This page does not exist.
notFound.description: The address may be outdated or incomplete. Return home to continue.

meta.title: Fullstack Frontend Template
meta.description: Reusable components, themes, and fullstack integration without product-specific features.

theme.title: Theme preview
theme.description: Signal Teal and Neutral share geometry, typography, and interaction states in light and dark modes.
theme.persistence: Appearance and language are saved in this browser.

gallery.title: Component library
gallery.description: Business-neutral examples of the shared template components. Search uses a local fixture; sharing opens a public example URL only after an explicit action.
gallery.dialogDescription: This is a reusable dialog. No data will be submitted.
gallery.popoverDescription: A popover uses the same theme tokens as the rest of the page.
gallery.tooltip: Keyboard focus also reveals this tooltip.
gallery.posterResult: A neutral poster example supplied by the calling page.
gallery.queryLabel: Find a component or enter a query
gallery.queryDescription: Local example data; not a backend search service.
gallery.queryPlaceholder: Try Dialog or type a free-form query
gallery.shareDescription: Share text, links, or a generated image. Browser capabilities determine the available actions.

share.title: Share preview
share.description: Review the content before choosing a sharing action.
share.imageUnavailable: Image unavailable. Text and link actions are still available.
share.noActions: No supported sharing actions are available in this browser.

errors.unsupported: This action is not supported in this browser.
errors.blocked: The browser blocked the share window.
